questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran license plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe through work zones. Fines may double in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-pointing triangular signs mean yield. Slow down and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Some vehicles travel at 25 mph or slower, such as bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, or farm equipment. This emblem warns other drivers to expect a slow-moving vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells drivers that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and prepare to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Proceed with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to the right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: Your lane is splitting into two directions. You can turn left or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yield means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass first. Then you can proceed with the remaining directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. Orange construction signs alert you to upcoming construction or maintenance work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you to a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs indicate a school zone or school crossing. Stay alert and be ready to stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to bicycle crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and sides. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black lettering marks a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-way, two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.
